title: The Story behind the Dented Pot
youtube_title: The Story behind the Dented Pot | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet attention can be warmer than advice.
summary: At a porch while rain ticks and nobody is late, Nana Ruth begins to tell Anil about a story behind a dented pot that was not a sad story. Anil wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
